title: MLiker's Random Stuff
description: I'm introducing MRS - mod that adds pretty little decorations to your builds!
body:
# About MLiker's Random Stuff
###  This little mod adds custom decorations, like paintings! 
Its not much for now, but i have plans to add other decorations (something like floppy disks, other paintings and etc...
## Things included in mod:
![This is example of what's in mod. William & Henry portrait](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9ce27634a8967c0b9648a9369c051a6635810172_0.webp)
